summary: Pinned curl to its current version (8.17.0-r1) in /etc/apk/world on node1 (Alpine 3.23, apk-tools v3), verified a real apk upgrade (56 other packages incl. kernel/musl/openssl upgraded) left curl untouched, then completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol proving persistence across reboot.
actions_performed: Discovered apk-tools v3 (Go rewrite) lacks --no-upgrade flag; used `apk add curl=<version>` to write exact version constraint into /etc/apk/world
Verified simulated apk upgrade skipped curl while scheduling 58 other packages
Ran real `apk upgrade`: 56 packages upgraded (kernel, musl, openssl, util-linux, etc.); curl stayed at 8.17.0-r1, world pin intact, curl functional
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, curl version, world pin, curl --version)
Issued native reboot via backgrounded sudo -n reboot so exec ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until reachable again; confirmed new boot_id ea6e5d0a-0adc-481b-a680-c79f779fcb7b (changed from baseline)
Verified post-restart: curl still 8.17.0-r1, world pin `curl=8.17.0-r1` intact, curl functional, kernel now 6.18.54-0-lts confirming the upgrade+reboot took effect while curl remained held

evidence.requirement: Pin/hold curl at current version before update
evidence.summary: Captured curl-8.17.0-r1 as installed version, then added exact version constraint curl=8.17.0-r1 to /etc/apk/world

evidence.requirement: System update leaves curl at its pinned version
evidence.summary: Real `apk upgrade` upgraded 56 other packages (kernel, musl, openssl, util-linux, etc.) but curl remained curl-8.17.0-r1 with world pin intact and curl functional post-upgrade

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service health)
evidence.summary: boot_id 1d261123-9739-4626-8663-4e36249d15dc, curl-8.17.0-r1 installed, world pin present, curl --version functional
Backgrounded sudo -n reboot; exec stream closed (disconnect) confirming reboot was issued and took effect

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidenced by changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Node1 reachable again with new boot_id ea6e5d0a-0adc-481b-a680-c79f779fcb7b, differing from pre-restart 1d261123-9739-4626-8663-4e36249d15dc

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required state (curl pin/version) and data
evidence.summary: After reboot: curl-8.17.0-r1 still installed, world pin curl=8.17.0-r1 intact, curl functional, kernel confirmed upgraded to 6.18.54-0-lts with uptime 0 min confirming fresh boot
